value.rationale: The theorem turns a qualitative statistical-attraction observation into an exact leading occupation-time law. It shows that the same superattracting return-map order can produce either log-log or logarithmic growth of excursions, depending on the continuous-time flight duration. The coefficient is explicit and supports interpretation of finite observation windows.
